LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 2.3.1 SUBJECT-VERB AGREEMENT

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Language use 2.3.1 Subject-verb agreement
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 2.3.1 Subject-verb agreement, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do you talk about a person, an object or a place? 2.How do we talk about many people?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 2.3.1 Subject-verb agreement together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: A learner’s ability to speak clearly and effectively is nurtured as they ask questions and engage in a dialogue

with peers using the target language pattern.

● Learning to learn- A learner works independently as they construct sentences showing subject-verb agreement.

Values:
Responsibility A learner ask each other questions using the target language pattern.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills – (self-esteem): The learner’s self-awareness level is enhanced as they construct simple sentences with correct subject-verb agreement.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner applies the grammatical knowledge acquired on subject-verb agreement to the learning of similar concept in Kiswahili Language
